original_benchmark.notes: Nine source tasks (tasks/GT001-GT009), each with 2-8 context arms declared in its task.toml [variants]; 28 (task, arm) units in total. The original harness (tasks/harness/rollout.py, --driver native --topology container) runs the agent at a shell in an episode container with the world's services in a sibling container, and grades with each task's deterministic grade.py plus the outcome/progress/path/reward composition of report.py.

harbor_adapter.notes: One Harbor task per (task, arm), named alkera/<task-id-lowercase>__<arm>. The world is built once at export time with the source builder and re-rooted into the image; a separate no-network verifier regrades from the /world, /workspace and /audit artifacts. instruction.md is byte-identical to the harness prompt except the dbt profile path (/home/engineer/.dbt). Deviations from the measured topology: one container instead of compose, agent user engineer instead of root, Postgres/MinIO not started (no task uses them), services bound to 127.0.0.1. Parity experiments against the source harness have not been run yet.
